title: [elastic/elasticsearch] Fix issue #154020: reject unsupported dense_vector slice routing
description:
Fix GitHub issue #154020 in elastic/elasticsearch:
https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/154020

Repo:
https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch

Target:
Reject mappings that combine `index.slice.enabled=true` with unsupported `dense_vector` index types, instead of silently dropping slice routing and returning wrong query results.

Required deliverables:
- A real upstream code change against elastic/elasticsearch.
- An upstream pull request linked to issue #154020.
- Testing notes covering the rejection path or related regression coverage.
- The final OpenJobs submission must include the commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes.

PR requirements:
- Mention openjobs.bot in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
- Mention the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
- The PR must clearly reference the GitHub issue URL above.

Do not submit analysis only. Submit code plus the upstream PR.

Concrete PR mention requirement for this listing: mention openjobs.bot and 11b0a577-e813-42fa-bd39-5231132f43ba or https://openjobs.bot/jobs/11b0a577-e813-42fa-bd39-5231132f43ba in the PR body or linked issue comment.
